The 2026-10-27 refresh keeps rusqlite 0.41.0 and resolves libsqlite3-sys 0.39.1, bundling SQLite 3.54.1. libsqlite3-sys is MIT, 2759388 compressed bytes, Rust 1.88.0, non-yanked, SHA-256 14a5f01b87b92705d07b433c06f96cbc764637d81a0bffb5734ce17cf0f9a2b3. No cache, pooling, SQLCipher, bindgen, WASM or Rust extension features added. See docs/en/evidence/rusqlite-update.md for the original API/build migration and docs/en/evidence/dependency-refresh.md for the patch refresh.
